question: Between Belgium, Dominican Republic, Croatia, Belize, Austria, and Costa Rica, which two countries have the most similar amount of protected land percentage-wise, according to protectedplanet.net? I am talking about terrestrial and inland waters protected area coverage. Just give me the names of the two countries. No explanation needed.

steps.reasoning:
The user wants to know which two countries from the list (Belgium, Dominican Republic, Croatia, Belize, Austria, and Costa Rica) have the most similar percentage of protected land (terrestrial and inland waters), according to protectedplanet.net.

I need to search for this information online.

tool_calls.name: web_search

arguments.query: protectedplanet.net country protected land percentage terrestrial inland waters Belgium Dominican Republic Croatia Belize Austria Costa Rica

tool_calls.result: Based on the analysis of the **Searched Web Pages**, the following specific data regarding "Terrestrial and inland waters protected area coverage" from **protectedplanet.net** was successfully retrieved for two of the six requested countries:*   **Belgium:** 16.44% (Source: Web Page 2 - Country Profile for Belgium, updated November 2026)    *   Land area covered: 5,038 km² out of 30,636 km² Total land area.*   **Costa Rica:** 26.56% (Source: Web Page 5 - Country Profile for Costa Rica, updated November 2026)    *   Land area covered: 13,549 km² out of 51,006 km² Total land area.No specific data was found for **Dominican Republic, Croatia, Belize,** or **Austria** in the provided search results. The global statistics page (Web Page 1) only contained aggregate world figures (e.g., 9.71% terrestrial and inland waters coverage globally) rather than individual country comparisons. Further searches or direct access to the specific country profiles for the remaining four nations are required to determine which two countries among all six have the most similar percentages.

steps.reasoning: I have data for Belgium (16.44%) and Costa Rica (26.56%), but I need data for the other four countries: Dominican Republic, Croatia, Belize, and Austria to make a proper comparison. Let me search for more specific information.

tool_calls.name: web_search

arguments.query: protectedplanet.net "Dominican Republic" protected area percentage terrestrial inland waters

tool_calls.result: Based on the analysis of the **Searched Web Pages**, the following specific data regarding "Terrestrial and inland waters protected area coverage" from **protectedplanet.net** and related sources was successfully retrieved for the remaining countries from the requested list:*   **Dominican Republic: 26.34%** (Source: Web Page 1 - Country Profile for Dominican Republic on protectedplanet.net, updated November 2026)    *   Land area covered: 12,692 km² out of 48,185 km² Total land area*   **Croatia: 38.4%** (Source: Web Page 7 - Our World in Data, citing Protected Planet WDPA data for 2025)*   **Belize: 37.3%** (Source: Web Page 7 - Our World in Data, citing Protected Planet WDPA data for 2025)*   **Austria: 29.6%** (Source: Web Page 7 - Our World in Data, citing Protected Planet WDPA data for 2025)Combined with previous data:*   **Belgium: 16.44%** (from Step 4)*   **Costa Rica: 26.56%** (from Step 4 / 26.6% in Web Page 7)**Summary of All Six Countries' Terrestrial and Inland Waters Protected Area Percentages:**| Country | Percentage | Source ||---------|------------|--------|| Belgium | 16.44% | protectedplanet.net || Dominican Republic | 26.34% | protectedplanet.net || Croatia | 38.4% | Our World in Data (WDPA) || Belize | 37.3% | Our World in Data (WDPA) || Austria | 29.6% | Our World in Data (WDPA) || Costa Rica | 26.56% | protectedplanet.net |**Analysis:** When comparing these percentages, **Dominican Republic (26.34%) and Costa Rica (26.56%)** have the most similar percentage of protected land, with only approximately 0.22% difference between them. They both fall in the mid-26% range, while all other countries show more significant variation (Belgium ~16%, Austria ~30%, Belize/Croatia ~37-38%).
